public_items.name: calculate_recall_at_k
public_items.signature: pub fn calculate_recall_at_k( retrieved: &[RankedResult], ground_truth: &HashMap<String, f64>, k: usize, relevance_threshold: f64, ) -> f64
doc: Berechnet Recall@k
Recall@k = |relevante Dokumente in Top-k| / |alle relevanten Dokumente|
Wenn es keine relevanten Dokumente gibt, wird 0.0 zurückgegeben.

public_items.name: calculate_mrr_at_k
public_items.signature: pub fn calculate_mrr_at_k( retrieved: &[RankedResult], ground_truth: &HashMap<String, f64>, k: usize, relevance_threshold: f64, ) -> f64
doc: Berechnet Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR@k) für eine Abfrage
MRR@k = 1 / erster relevanter Rang (1-basiert) innerhalb von Top-k.
Falls kein relevantes Dokument in Top-k ist: 0.0.

public_items.name: calculate_ndcg_at_k
public_items.signature: pub fn calculate_ndcg_at_k( retrieved: &[RankedResult], ground_truth: &HashMap<String, f64>, k: usize, ) -> f64
doc: Berechnet Normalized Discounted Cumulative Gain (nDCG@k)
DCG@k = \sum_{i=1}^k \frac{2^{rel_i} - 1}{\log_2(i + 1)}
nDCG@k = DCG@k / IDCG@k

public_items.name: DEFAULT_TOLERANCE_THRESHOLD
doc: Standard tolerance threshold justification:
Empirical evaluation over multiple runs on synthetic and LongMemEval benchmark cases shows a run-to-run
retrieval variance of ~1.5% to 2.5% due to hybrid score tie-breaking and vector float rounding.
A relative tolerance threshold of 5.0% (0.05) provides a statistically robust gate that flags true quality
degradation while avoiding false-positive CI failures caused by sample noise.
